(()=>{const frames=document.querySelectorAll('iframe');if(frames.length)throw Error('Use standalone urinal page for this recipe');for(let i=0;i<6;i++){document.querySelector('[data-step="'+i+'"]').click();const s=window.__urinal.getState();if(s.stage!==i||document.body.dataset.step!==String(i))throw Error('Stage mismatch');if(document.querySelectorAll('[aria-pressed="true"][data-step]').length!==1)throw Error('Step selection mismatch');const seal=document.querySelector('[data-part="membrane.flex"]');if(!seal)throw Error('Missing diaphragm');const wet=getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-part="trap.water3"]')).display;if((wet!=='none')!==(i===3||i===4))throw Error('Outlet flow remains after flush');const upperDots=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-dot="pilot.high"]')].filter(d=>d.style.opacity!=='0');if(!!upperDots.length!==s.pilot)throw Error('Pilot flow disagrees');if(i===1&&(s.pilot||s.flow))throw Error('Presence must not flush')}window.__urinal.setStep(0);if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow');return {steps:6,width:innerWidth,geometry:'present',reduced:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches};})()
